title: Tooling Baseline Validation
description: Invoke a development helper tool (scenario-auditor, test-genie, scenario-completeness-scoring) against a golden via its CLI; capture stdout/exit; evaluate against a per-tool expectation; produce a verdict.

requirements.title: Tool invocation runner
requirements.description: Subprocess runner that shells out to the tool's CLI with appropriate flags (--json where available), captures stdout/stderr/exit, enforces a per-tool timeout, and persists the raw output for the evaluator and for operator debugging.

validation.notes: Worker invokes the ToolRunner seam, captures the result, and persists a tool-run record.

requirements.title: Per-tool expectation evaluator
requirements.description: Pluggable evaluators (one per tool) that parse the captured output and produce a verdict. Initial implementations: scenario-auditor (zero violations except documented orientation-noise allowlist), test-genie (comprehensive preset all phases pass), scenario-completeness-scoring (score >= configured floor, default 96).

validation.notes: Successful tool result maps to pass.
Failed tool result maps to the tool-failure verdict.
